text: TRUMP WARNS DENMARK: “Not a Thing Denmark Can Do” — Trump Doubles Down on Taking GreenlandU.S. President Donald Trump on Wednesday reiterated his long-standing view that the United States needs Greenland for national and broader European security, saying Denmark would be unable to prevent geopolitical shifts involving the Arctic territory. Speaking at the White House, Trump cited concerns over Russia and China increasing their presence in the region, adding that the issue had been debated by U.S. leaders for over a century.
